meta.title: Everstead — Your life, organised.
meta.description: Everstead helps UK families securely organise accounts, documents, instructions, and final wishes — with AI that helps you every step of the way. Start your free trial today.
meta.ogDescription: Everstead is the secure home for your accounts, documents, and important decisions — organised for you today, and ready for your family when it counts.
meta.jsonLdDescription: Secure personal vault for UK families. Organise accounts, documents, and important decisions — accessible today, and ready for your loved ones when it matters.

hero.eyebrow: Organise your accounts, documents & final wishes
hero.title2: in one secure place for your family.
hero.subtitle: Everstead is the secure place to keep everything your loved ones will need, set up in minutes and shared only with the people you choose.
hero.trustpilotAria: Rated Excellent on Trustpilot — read our reviews
hero.mobilePhotoAlt: A daughter and her father organising their family's plan together at home

access.label: Access management
access.sub: You decide who can see what

why.subtitle: No more scattered logins, lost paperwork, or guesswork left behind. Just a clear, gentle record of a life well organised.

accounts.title: Accounts & assets
accounts.desc: Every account, policy and subscription in one clear list — so nothing quietly slips through the cracks.

documents.title: Documents & wishes
documents.desc: Wills, deeds, letters and instructions — stored safely, easy to find, and impossible to misplace.

people.title: People & access
people.desc: Decide who sees what, and when. Your family is only ever a step away — never a guess.

current.title: Up to date, without the chore.
current.desc: Gentle reminders and one-tap updates mean your Everstead reflects your life as it is now — not as it was five years ago. The hard part stays done.
bullets: Quiet nudges only when something needs a look
A clear sense of what's complete and what's left
current.imageAlt: A quiet monthly summary in Everstead — home insurance renewed, a new ISA added, and a gentle nudge that a passport expires in six months

share.eyebrow: Yours to share, on your terms
share.title: Share exactly what you choose.
share.desc: Give a partner full access, a child a single document, or a solicitor a sealed envelope opened only when the time comes. You stay in control, always.
bullets: Trusted contacts notified only when needed
share.imageAlt: People & access in Everstead — a partner with full access, a daughter with a single document, and a solicitor sealed until needed

steps.title: Easier than you'd think — and never for nothing.
steps.subtitle: A few quiet minutes now means the people you love won't spend weeks piecing it together later.

items.title: Bring it together
items.desc: Add accounts, documents and wishes whenever it suits you — a few minutes at a time is plenty.

items.title: Keep it current
items.desc: Small, gentle nudges keep everything accurate and complete, so it's always ready.

items.title: Pass it on
items.desc: Choose who's notified, and what they can see, if and when the time ever comes.

reassurance.title: Planning ahead is an act of care.
reassurance.desc: Everstead turns confusion into clarity. It gives your loved ones practical direction when decisions are time-sensitive and emotions are running high — a gift they will genuinely appreciate.
reassurance.imageAlt: The Everstead app — your plan organised: accounts and assets, documents and wishes, and the people you trust

security.title: Built on the highest security standards — and controlled entirely by you.
security.desc: Everstead runs on bank-grade AES-256 encryption and UK-hosted, UK GDPR-compliant infrastructure. Your information stays private by default — visible only to the people you choose, only the parts you choose, and only when you decide. It's your vault, and you decide who ever gets in.

pricing.title: Simple, honest pricing.
pricing.subtitle: Save 20% with yearly billing, all in pounds.

free.name: Everstead
free.desc: Get started and organise the essentials — at no cost, with no card.

family.name: Everstead+
family.desc: For couples and families — two private vaults, one subscription. Organised together, private separately.
features: Each person keeps their own private data

advisor.name: Everstead Pro
advisor.desc: For professionals managing client estate organisation. Pricing on application.
advisor.note: Pricing on application — we're working personally with our first adviser cohort.

pricing.trialNote: Free forever — no card required. Everstead+ includes a 14-day free trial; your card isn't charged until it ends.

app.title: Your plan, in your pocket.
app.desc: Add documents, check your readiness score, and keep everything up to date from your phone. Now on the App Store and Google Play.

gift.eyebrow: A gift that says: I've sorted it.
gift.title: Give Everstead to a parent, partner, or someone you love.
gift.desc: The kind of present they'd never buy themselves — and the one that genuinely takes weight off their family one day. Sent as a digital gift, redeemable any time.
